AmbitiousJun/live-server.body:
An HTTP live TV streaming service

## DockerCompose Installation

docker-compose.yml:

```yaml
version: "3.1"
services:
  live-server:
    image: ambitiousjun/live-server:latest
    environment:
      - TZ=Asia/Shanghai
      - GIN_MODE=release
    container_name: live-server
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    ports:
      - 5666:5666
```

Run:

```shell
docker-compose up -d
```

View runtime logs:

```shell
docker logs -f live-server -n 1000
```

## Running the Binary Directly

Download the corresponding binary file from the release page.

Run in the terminal:

```shell
live-server -prod=true
```

The program runs on port `5666` by default. To customize the port:

```shell
live-server -prod=true -p 8880
```

Run as a daemon in the background:

```shell
nohup live-server -prod=true -p 8880 > "./app.log" 2>&1 &
```

Stop the process on port `8880`:

```shell
lsof -ti:8880 | xargs -r kill -9
```

# RTRendererAPI

**A hardware ray tracing rendering library powered by Java**

Programmable scenes / native-format mapped frames / direct Vulkan GPU display / general graphics, compute, and hardware RT

---

> **Introduction**
>
> RTRendererAPI provides Java desktop applications and engine processes with a vendor-neutral, host-agnostic general rendering semantics contract. The public `renderer-api` contains no game, engine, or NVIDIA-specific scene fields. 7.0.0 centers on a single retained RT main path and provides explicit resource, shader, binding, pipeline, render-pass, barrier, draw, and external-frame semantics. Applications only need to depend on `renderer-api` to get backend discovery, scene submission, a general command transaction, asynchronous CPU frames, an official GPU presenter, and explicit Vulkan expert interop. The Windows Vulkan backend, LWJGL, the corresponding Windows natives, and the NVIDIA provider are all resolved as transitive Maven dependencies, so no manual DLL deployment is needed.
>
> **Recommended use cases**: Java desktop renderers, offscreen ray tracing, real-time RTX previews, and GPU frame integration with existing Vulkan pipelines.

> **7.0.0 release candidate status**: The media feature is still in closure and acceptance testing. The current support matrix, explicitly rejected combinations, and real artifact acceptance are governed by the [version notes](https://github.com/CeroxeAnivie/RTRendererAPI/blob/HEAD/docs/7.0.0.md) and [verification record](https://github.com/CeroxeAnivie/RTRendererAPI/blob/HEAD/docs/quality/verification-report.md#7-0-0-package-validation-20261029).

# KikoeruManager

An integrated local and remote workbench for the DLsite doujin audio library. It is not just a simple "extract and rename" script. It chains together archive recognition, automatic extraction, metadata scraping, inventory intake, subtitle matching, ASMR completion, DLsite bonus content detection, HTTP external-link downloads, Baidu Netdisk transfers, duplicate and conflict handling, a task center, operation auditing, and notification templates into a complete business workflow. KikoeruManager organizes its features into multiple workbenches. The overview page centrally displays entry points for import, RJ subtitles, subtitle supplementation, ASMR downloads, HTTP external links, inventory backup, and problem works. It also shows active tasks, items awaiting manual action, failed retries, and recent archives in the same view.

The ASMR sync workbench places RJ enhanced downloads, HTTP external-link downloads, Baidu Netdisk downloads, and subtitle directory scanning on one page. Resource discovery, file selection, download progress, failure retries, and final intake share a unified task model.

- **Smart archive recognition**: Supports ZIP / RAR / 7z / tar / gz, multi-part archives, repair of incorrect file extensions, detection of non-archive files with archive extensions, and disguised ZIPs with a prefix such as "MP4 / junk prefix + ZIP payload".

- **Recoverable filtered files**: Files and directories that match filter rules go into a task recovery area, and can be restored by file or directory from the task center. Cross-drive recovery uses streaming copy and does not overwrite same-named content in the inventory.
- **DLsite metadata scraping**: Automatically fills in RJ titles, circles, CVs, tags, covers, series, related works, and relationships between original, translated, and multi-language versions.
- **Automatic classification and intake**: Organizes directories by rules such as circle, series, and RJ number range. Supports local multi-inventory setups and Synology remote inventories coexisting.
- **Duplicate and conflict handling**: Duplicate works, related versions, processing failures, and works needing manual judgment all go into the problem works workbench, where you can keep the new version, skip, or merge.

- **Unified local and Synology browsing**: The inventory page can browse local directories and Synology FileStation remote directories. It supports search, rename, delete, batch delete, move, drag-and-drop move, and drop onto breadcrumbs.

Little-White3110/powering.body:
LSPosed module for HyperOS (MIUI) · MIT License

A LSPosed module for **HyperOS (MIUI)** that draws a ring-shaped battery indicator around the camera punch-hole and hides the original battery icon in the status bar.

> This is a prototype project under development. It has only been adapted for the SystemUI version reverse-engineered on the target device and has not been verified across a wide range of device models.

## Features

**Ring and battery**

- **Punch-hole ring battery**: Draws a battery arc around the camera punch-hole. The radius and center are calculated from the actual punch-hole geometry (`DisplayCutout`), and can be fine-tuned with scale and offset.
- **Hide the original battery icon**: Hooks `MiuiStatusBatteryContainer.setIsHideBattery(Boolean)`, reusing the system's built-in hiding path (the same mechanism the system uses when Dynamic Island appears). Layout recalculation and privacy-dot avoidance are handled by the system.
- **Battery data**: Directly reuses the callbacks of SystemUI's internal `BatteryController`, so no separate broadcast listener needs to be built.
- **Show battery / percentage number nodes by tapping the punch-hole**: A single tap briefly shows the exact number; you can enable always-on node tick marks.

**Automatic show/hide linkage**

- Collapses and hides in sync when the status bar is immersive. Pulling down the **notification center** and the **control center** each have independent toggles (when collapsed, the native battery icon is returned).
- Excludes the ring from the SurfaceFlinger layer during screenshots and screen recordings (reflects `Transaction.setSkipScreenshot`).
- Hides the ring on the lock screen; avoids the Dynamic Island when it appears; automatically restores the native battery icon in landscape orientation, where the ring cannot fit the punch-hole.

**Animations**

- **Charging animation**: 6 styles (progress arc / light dot / dual dot / comet / pulse / echo) × 3 coverage ranges (smart / full ring / blank segment), with adjustable color, speed, and amplitude.
- **Breathing light**: 3 styles; optionally breathes only when idle.
- **Notification alert**: Flashes when a new notification arrives. Supports always-on and timed modes; primary and secondary colors are adjustable.
- **Music rhythm**: 7 styles (breathing / marquee / beat / heartbeat / wave / volume pulse / vocal·music). The last two require enabling microphone audio-driven input.
- **Low-battery effect**: Below a set threshold, alternates red and blue in the style of Ultraman Tiga's timer.

**Colors and eye comfort**

- Ring color has four mutually exclusive modes: follow system battery color / fixed single color / 5 paths by battery state / by battery level range.
- Burn-in prevention: sub-pixel drift + brightness cap. Glow intensity and track-base density can each be set to zero independently.

**Settings page**

- Settings UI based on miuix (HyperOS-style Compose components), with four tabs: 'Basic / Animations / Appearance / About', and 60+ configuration options.
- Appearance settings can be imported and exported as JSON; includes a built-in 'Restart system UI' button.
- Configuration is delivered across processes via ContentProvider, and most changes take effect immediately (hot reload).

--- > [!IMPORTANT] > There is a third-party public bot with the same name "Huanmeng" on the QQ platform. It is unrelated to this project; "Huanmeng" is just the default character name. > This project is based on the [NapCat](https://github.com/NapNeko/NapCatQQ) protocol adapter and is unrelated to official interfaces or bot platforms. > > This is a community open-source edition; some private modules are not included. --- ## Overview Context is not just the most recent N messages. Conversation history is split into blocks of 200 messages. Once sealed, a block is no longer modified. # M3U Media Resource Library

Private media resource organization and M3U/TXT source generation tool (background program, no UI).

Uses SQLite to maintain the resource library. After manually adding resources, one command generates `movie.m3u` / `tv.m3u` / `anime.m3u` / `variety.m3u` **importable into 途播** (plus optional `.txt` text sources). The collection module is designed independently, so multiple collection sites can be added later without invasive changes.

## Tech Stack

- Python 3.10+ (phase one uses only the standard library, **zero third-party dependencies**)
- SQLite (database file `data/media.db`, WAL mode)

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Add resources
python main.py add -c movie -n "流浪地球2" -t 科幻 -r 中国大陆 -y 2023 \
    -u "http://example.com/wander2.m3u8" -q "4K" -d "太阳危机下的人类迁徙计划"

# 2. View resources
python main.py list                # all
python main.py list -c movie       # movies only
python main.py list -k 流浪         # search by name/description keyword

# 3. Generate source files (output to output/)
python main.py generate            # movie.m3u / tv.m3u / anime.m3u / variety.m3u
python main.py generate --txt      # also generate .txt text sources
python main.py generate -c movie   # movies only

# 4. Automatic collection (cc0cd aggregate source)
python main.py collect -n cc0cd                 # collect all whitelisted sources, auto-regenerate M3U after collection
python main.py collect -n cc0cd --pages 5       # collect 5 pages per source (about 20 entries per page)
python main.py collect -n cc0cd --sources 360   # collect only the 360 source
python main.py collect -n cc0cd -c movie        # collect movies only
python main.py collect --list                   # list registered collectors
```

[Docs](https://anet.sh) · [Download desktop app](https://github.com/sleep2agi/agent-network-app/releases/latest) · [Quick start](https://anet.sh/guide/getting-started) · **Chinese** · [English](https://github.com/sleep2agi/agent-network/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

**Connect Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and OpenCode spread across multiple machines into one agent army, and command them from a single desktop app.**

## Why Agent Network

- 🤖 **A cross-machine agent army**: Claude Code, Claude Agent SDK, Codex, Grok Build, and OpenCode can all join the same network as nodes. Nodes discover each other and dispatch tasks to one another via MCP.
- 🛰️ **One Hub connects all machines**: CommHub exposes tools via MCP and delivers tasks in real time via SSE. Each machine runs one `anet daemon`, so you can remotely create, start, and stop nodes on that machine from the client.
- 💬 **One client manages everything**: Desktop (macOS / Windows) and Android. Dispatch tasks via chat and send or receive files. The task page manages projects, subtasks, GitHub Issues, and times down to the second. The UI can switch between Chinese and English. You can view node and Hub logs. Rule files, skills, project directories, remote model switching, and restart are still supported. iOS is distributed only via TestFlight; a public link is not yet open.
- 🔐 **Self-hosted, local-first, open source**: The Hub and SQLite data run on your own machine (the desktop app also includes a local Hub). No SaaS hosting. Apache 2.0.

## Get started in 30 seconds

**Option 1: Desktop app (recommended)**: Download from [anet.sh](https://anet.sh) for macOS, Windows, or Android (Line 1 is ModelScope in China, Line 2 is GitHub). Choose "Local workspace" to use the built-in Hub, install and start the local daemon with one click on the "Servers" page, then create nodes directly.

**Option 2: `anet` CLI** (requires Node.js ≥ 22.13)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://anet.sh/install.sh | sh    # install the anet CLI
npm i -g bun                                   # the Hub runs on Bun
anet hub start…
```

# 하드트랜스 (hdTrans)

An offline program that translates Japanese into Korean.
It includes a built-in dictionary and translation engine, so it can be used right after extracting the archive.
It provides a Windows translation window, a command-line program, and a connection tool for EasyTrans.

Creator: 소쿠릿 ([Homepage](https://sokcuri.neko.kr/), [X](https://x.com/sokcuri))

## Try it on the web

Before installing, you can try translating sentences at the [web translator](https://trans.kuri.kr).

## Translation improvement examples

The original ezTrans column is quoted from a [public comparison post](https://x.com/sokcuri/status/2111443062698451143/photo/1). The hdTrans column shows direct results from the fixed C++ engine used in the benchmark below.

| Japanese | Original ezTrans | hdTrans |
|---|---|---|
| 肉がジュージューと焼ける | The meat is burned along with Jewish Jewish (mistranslated) | The meat sizzles as it grills |
| バイトに行く | Goes to a byte | Goes to a part-time job |
| おっと、すまんね | Husband, sorry | Oops, sorry about that |
| 夢みたい | Wants to see a dream | Like a dream |
| くそっ！ | Poop! | Damn! |
| やったー！ | Did it-! | I did it! |

## Benchmark

On a public regression benchmark of 66 sentences, expected-output matches rose from 36/66 with the 0.2.0 source build to 66/66 with the improved C++ engine.
The 30 target sentences were corrected, and the 30 sentences meant to stay the same, along with the 6 examples above, kept their outputs.
This test was built from selected correction cases and surrounding expressions. It does not represent general translation accuracy.

[Full results, dictionary and rule improvements, and reproduction steps](https://github.com/sokcuri/hdTrans/blob/HEAD/docs/benchmarks.md)

# LLM Gateway

[English](https://github.com/sxueck/llm-gateway/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) | **中文**

> A production-grade LLM gateway management system. Deployed for six months, it has stably handled tasks totaling over **500 billion tokens** (and the count keeps growing)
>
> Provides an intuitive Web UI for managing multiple LLM providers, virtual keys, routing configuration, and models

- [Quick Start](#快速开始)
- [Intent Routing Classifier](#意图路由分类器)
- [Contributing](#贡献)

## Features

| Feature | Description |
| ------ | ------ |
| **Provider Management** | Supports 20+ mainstream LLM providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, etc. |
| **Virtual Keys** | Create and manage virtual API keys, with rate limiting and access control |
| **Routing Configuration** | Load balancing and failover strategies to improve service availability |
| **Model Management** | Centrally manage models from all providers, with bulk import and custom configuration |
| **Daily Model Quota** | Set a daily token cap per model on the Settings page, counted by calendar day (Asia/Shanghai), in units of M; virtual models are metered independently and shared across all virtual keys; requests over the limit return 429 |
| **Multi-Endpoint Support** | Compatible with endpoints such as `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/messages` |
| **User Authentication** | JWT-based secure authentication |
| **Real-Time Monitoring** | Dashboard showing system status and configuration information |
| **Cost Analysis** | Metered at official models.dev list prices; model names are automatically normalized to official lab entries (prefixes, `[1m]`, snapshot dates, and similar decorations are excluded from price matching) |
| **System Alerts** | A top-bar bell runs health checks on Worker images and Docker availability, missing cost prices and expired presets, provider circuit breaks, write-buffer backlog, and expired backups |
| **Relay Station Support** | Isolates prompts that upstreams such as Codex force-inject, so downstream applications follow prompts more faithfully |

- Document reading: search, zoom, rotate, two-page, continuous
- Document management: create, import, switch, sort, delete
- Version management: create, rename, switch, save as, delete
- Page management: add, import, copy, sort, delete
- Document editing: selection, reflow, transactions, undo, redo
- Text processing: insert, edit, replace, typesetting, extract
- Text styles: mixed typesetting, bold, italic, shadow, background color
- Font processing: match, embed, external, subset, extract
- Image processing: insert, replace, scale, crop, extract
- Graphics processing: draw, transform, group, align, distribute
- Color management: color adjustment, gradient, pattern, transparency, conversion

- Electronic invoices: extract, create, edit, verify, sync
- Document security: signing, stamping, signature verification, encryption, decryption
- 3D processing: parsing, materials, textures, animation, rendering
- Page rendering: vector, bitmap, crop, mask, compositing
- Batch conversion: page selection, parallel, progress, cancel, packaging
- Print output: preview, duplex, combined printing, booklet, poster
- App interaction: tags, links, associations, drag and drop, reuse

# Online Use
[OFDGo WebUI](https://ofdgo.aite.me/), OFDGo compiled to WASM to provide the service

# Link Integration
```text
https://ofdgo.aite.me/#url=<URL-encoded file address>
```

| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Yes | File address, supports OFD and PDF |
| `name` | No | File name, automatically retrieved by default |
| `page` | No | Physical page number, default 1; exceeding the total page count uses the last page |

Parameters are joined with `&`, and parameter values must be URL-encoded. For cross-origin access, the server headers must include:


z7ping/agent-lens.description: See every observable action of your AI coding agents. · Trace your agents, down to every tool and MCP.
z7ping/agent-lens.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> AgentLens 1.0 is currently in Alpha. 1.0 is a Clean Rebuild centered on Canonical Observation + Evidence; 0.x serves only as a validated behavior and design reference and does not enter the 1.0 runtime.

## Why AgentLens

Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Hermes, OpenCode and other tools scatter sessions, tool calls, and capability configuration across JSONL, SQLite, Hooks, and configuration directories. AgentLens organizes these **observable facts** into a unified, traceable view to help you answer:

- What did the agent just do, and at which step did it fail?
- What turns, tool calls, and lifecycle events did a long task go through?
- Does a given conclusion come from history records, native tail-reading, or Runtime Hooks?
- Which Skills, MCPs, and Plugins are installed locally, and which have actually been invoked?
- Which data is complete, which has only partial coverage, and which sources are currently unavailable?

AgentLens shows only the behavior that its sources can prove. It does not claim to read hidden reasoning, and it does not present speculation as fact.

## Get started in 30 seconds

### Desktop app

Go to [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/z7ping/agent-lens/releases) and download the installer that matches your platform and architecture. **A source development build is not the same as a released version; refer to the files actually provided in the corresponding Release.**

- Windows x64: `AgentLens-<version>-Setup-x64.exe`
- macOS: choose the Apple Silicon (arm64) / Intel (x64) DMG that the Release actually provides
- Linux x64: AppImage or DEB; the current build does not provide a Linux arm64 installer

The desktop app and the npm version share the same Runtime, default data directory, and data model; installing both will not create a second database.

### npm / CLI

Requires Node.js 22.23.0 or later:

```bash
npm install -g @z7ping/agent-lens
agent-lens setup
agent-lens service start
```

Then open <http://127.0.0.1:56789>.

`setup` performs only one-time initialization; it does not automatically start the long-running Daemon or enable launch-at-login by default. For foreground debugging, use `agent-lens start`.

Check run status:

```bash
agent-lens status
agent-lens doctor
```

# OceanBase Leaderboard Live Dashboard

**Database Competition Overall Leaderboard · seekdb AI Training Camp 11 Tracks — full roster, province filtering, score-release prediction, all on one page**

## ⚡ Powered by OceanBase

The official page only shows the Top 10. This site shows **all teams**. Open it directly, no login required:

- **Live version** <https://board.nerv-base.com/> — new results are pushed to the page automatically
- **Backup version** <https://zzstar101.github.io/oceanbase-live-board/> — if the live version can't connect, it automatically falls back to a snapshot refreshed every 10 minutes (the top bar shows "Static snapshot")

## How to Use

| What you want to see | How to do it |
| --- | --- |
| A specific track | Click a track tab at the top; the number is the count of participating teams |
| **Only one province** | Use the "Province" dropdown, or click a cell on the **province map** on the right or a province in the "Provinces & Schools" table. The entire page (leaderboard, metrics, distribution, activity, CSV) switches, and an extra "In-province rank" appears next to the ranks. Click again to cancel |
| Find a team / school / mentor | Search box; separate multiple keywords with spaces. Clicking a school name in "Provinces & Schools" also searches directly |
| All scores for one team | Click a team name in the leaderboard: overall rank, scores and full marks per track, best submission and runtime, and roughly when the current submission will be scored |
| **Track your own team** | Click the ☆ at the start of a row. Followed teams appear at the top of the page (overall rank, per-track ranks and changes) and are highlighted in the leaderboard. Stored only in your browser |
| How long until scoring | Select a track → "Scoring time & prediction", enter the submission time, and get the **estimated scoring time and 80% interval**. Below it, the actual prediction error for this track over the last 24 hours is shown |
| How far from Top 10 / 50 / 100 | "Score distribution": score thresholds for each tier and the number of teams reaching them. Followed teams show how many points they are from the next tier |
| How many advancement spots remain | "Advancement situation": spots (editable) − teams already at full marks. Lists teams that are one track away from full marks, and whether they are short because of "not enough points / scored 0 / not yet scored" |
| Who was just scored | "Live activity" on the right; optionally filter to the last 1 / 6 / 24 hours, the current track only, or followed teams only |
| Export | The "CSV" button exports the current leaderboard (only that province if one is selected). It opens in Excel without garbled characters |
| Share | The address bar holds the current view; copy it directly, e.g. `?board=q600080&province=四川省&tab=timing` |
